q: In Ezra, which Persian king let the Jews go home to build God's house?
quote: the LORD stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia to send a proclamation

q: In Ezra, King Cyrus told God's people to go to Jerusalem and do what?
quote: and build the house of the LORD, the God of Israel

q: In Ezra, why did the people give a great shout of praise?
quote: because the foundation of the house of the LORD had been laid.

q: In Ezra, what did older people who had seen the first temple do at the new foundation?
quote: wept loudly when they saw the foundation of this temple.

q: In Ezra, what was Ezra skilled in?
quote: He was a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses

q: In Ezra, what had Ezra set his heart to do with the Law?
quote: For Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to practice it, and to teach its statutes

q: In Ezra, what did King Cyrus return that Nebuchadnezzar had taken?
quote: King Cyrus also brought out the articles belonging to the house of the LORD that Nebuchadnezzar had carried away

q: In Ezra, why could no one tell joyful shouts from weeping?
quote: The people could not distinguish the shouts of joy from the sound of weeping

q: In Ezra, what did the people of the land try to do to Judah's builders?
quote: Then the people of the land set out to discourage the people of Judah and make them afraid to build.

q: In Ezra, from which city did Ezra come up to Jerusalem?
quote: this Ezra came up from Babylon.

q: In Ezra, what did Ezra proclaim to ask God for a safe journey?
why: He would not ask the king for soldiers.
quote: And there by the Ahava Canal I proclaimed a fast

q: In Ezra, why was Ezra ashamed to ask the king for soldiers?
quote: For I was ashamed to ask the king for an escort of soldiers and horsemen

q: In Ezra, in which king's reign was the second temple completed?
quote: in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.

q: In Ezra, in which month was the second temple completed?
quote: And this temple was completed on the third day of the month of Adar

q: In Ezra, which leader built the altar with Jeshua the priest?
why: He was the son of Shealtiel.
quote: along with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his associates, began to build the altar

q: In Ezra, by which canal did Ezra proclaim a fast?
quote: And there by the Ahava Canal I proclaimed a fast
